synthetic_probe.scope: ELF representation only; LOAD/file padding may cover the unallocated-section gap.

limits: Only current captured known incoming/control and represented materializations are scanned; arbitrary dynamic callers and raw-image aliases are not excluded.
Source pointer atGP+84 may mutate; LBU thenAND7 pluszero guard bounds the observed read without assuming its content lifetime.
Known live base/effective pointer sinks are killed by original instructions before their next use; no C ABI clobber assumption substitutes for these raw proofs.
Interrupt context/register corruption, runtime code mutation and opaque memory side effects are not proved absent.
One-past is a numeric captured-carrier anchor, not original C same-object provenance or byte0 allocation.
Gap may be covered byLOAD/file padding; no physical-unmapped claim, executable firmware or BIN.
